entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Secret cult of Phyrexian sympathizers within the Tolarian Academies, worshipers of Mishra and Gix.

entities.name: Rona, Disciple of Gix
entities.description: Leader of the Society of Mishra.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Ancient order the society is a spiritual successor to.

entities.name: Tolarian Academies
entities.description: Institution within which the cult hid.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian helped by the society in staging a new invasion.

entities.name: Academy at Lat-Nam
entities.description: Became a haven for dark research.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which the Tolarians excised the society.

entities.name: Chancellor Uthras
entities.description: Led the society at Tolaria West.

entities.name: Death of Belzenlok
entities.description: Event shortly after the society's Tolaria West activities.

events.summary: The society helps Sheoldred stage a new invasion and takes control of the Academy at Lat-Nam.
events.quote: The society helped Sheoldred in staging a new invasion of the plane.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion the Tolarians excise the Society of Mishra.
events.quote: the Tolarians excised the Society of Mishra from their ranks

events.summary: The Traveler thwarts the society's attempt to create a hive-mind device.
events.quote: They attempted to create a hive-mind device but were thwarted by The Traveler
